mandatoryFindings.title: Initial authorization declares completeness before outside actor facts can enter the derived roster
mandatoryFindings.establishedBehavior: The installer forbids caller-supplied typedPriorActors/typedActorEvidencePins, has no narrow actualPriorActors input in its allowed scope/candidate graph, and derives the initial authorization as knownPostBaseActors plus its own pending installer row with typedActorRosterComplete:true. New owner-record writers/install-scope authors/source readers necessarily precede installation but can first enter through a later control-author request. The actual source-authored SETUP carrier is implemented and independently exercised, including outside PID901001, original separate tool trace, current-control evidence carrier and a qualifying fake negative. That later union cannot retroactively complete the immutable initial authorization.
mandatoryFindings.impact: The initial completeness assertion omits already known external actors under the inherited full-roster obligation. Its source-produced snapshot repeats that incomplete base. This is a missing initial producer/input binding, not a failure of the later pure-memory completion or carrier mechanism. No actual actor omission or unauthorized runtime operation was observed.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Provide a concrete reviewed initial-install input/producer path for narrow independently captured actual outside/install-scope/owner/source-reader actor facts and their provenance, deriving the initial typed roster/evidence from those facts before declaring it complete. Preserve no root-built binary/code/loader/member/input maps and no future self-completion/hash cycle. Alternatively, an explicitly limited initial record must remain non-complete/non-admitting until a separately defined complete boundary, with the full consumer/factory contract changed accordingly; do not relabel the present assertion by interpretation or treat later setup as retroactive completion. Keep every actual known ID/status meaning, pending designated installer and separately captured completion. All other source/physical/freshness safeguards remain.
